title: 2.1 Eubacteria
description: True bacteria: prokaryotic structure, cell wall, shapes, reproduction and metabolism. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? The domain of true bacteria with peptidoglycan cell walls
Which term matches this description? An organism whose cells lack a membrane-bound nucleus
Which term matches this description? A polymer that strengthens most bacterial cell walls
Which term matches this description? Bacteria that retain crystal violet stain in the Gram test
Which term matches this description? Bacteria that lose crystal violet and take the counterstain
Which term matches this description? Bacteria with a spherical cell shape, often forming clusters
Which term matches this description? Bacteria with a rod-like shape that may form chains
Which term matches this description? Bacteria with a rigid spiral shape and flagella
Which term matches this description? A whip-like structure used by bacteria for movement
Which term matches this description? Short hair-like structures that help bacteria attach to surfaces
Which term matches this description? A sticky outer covering that helps bacteria avoid drying out
Which term matches this description? A dormant structure formed by bacteria under stress
Which term matches this description? Asexual reproduction in which one cell splits into two
Which term matches this description? A small circular DNA molecule separate from the main chromosome
Which term matches this description? The irregular region of a bacterial cell that holds its DNA
Which term matches this description? A cell structure that carries out protein synthesis
Which term matches this description? An organism that synthesises its own organic compounds
Which term matches this description? An organism that obtains food from other organisms
Which term matches this description? Bacteria that use oxygen to release energy from food
Which term matches this description? Bacteria that grow in environments where oxygen is absent
